warning[ZBX-W0209]: groups show as nogroup inside the container
  cause  a run with devices keeps your groups; inside the container they show as
         'nogroup', and the host's file permissions still decide who may open
         each device
  fix    nothing to do; the groups work, only their names are not shown
  more   zbx explain W0209 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/W0209.html
warning[ZBX-W0208]: driver libraries found through LD_LIBRARY_PATH
  cause  the image has no usable ldconfig (or its root is read-only), so the
         driver libraries are found through LD_LIBRARY_PATH instead of the
         library cache
  fix    nothing to do for an image that finds them; a musl image such as Alpine cannot load glibc driver libraries, use a glibc image
  more   zbx explain W0208 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/W0208.html
